orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Scrapper Clans "Thunderknuckle", a hull mount (outward is up): the 4x3 housing: four mismatched nozzles welded into a fist (a grey pipe, a rust cone, a steel box, a taped stovepipe at different heights) on a palm of mismatched bolted plates with a weld across the top and a band of hazard tape; inside the Kickjet core with a crude painted fist, two motors, heavy tape and patches. Damaged: the stovepipe is bent and sputters, the box nozzle is cracked, tape is peeling off the palm, a plate lost its bolts, sparks. Disabled: the stovepipe snapped off, the cone bent over, the pipe hanging off its weld, the palm plates split, the core dead. THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
